experiences.title: Experience
experiences.idealistaDescription: I collaborated with the team to develop Idealista's new chat for non-professional users from scratch, enhancing both the system's user experience and scalability. I also contributed to the final phase of the chat redesign for professional users, ensuring high quality and optimal functionality. In addition, I designed and developed two reusable tools for both chat systems: an efficient media uploader and an integrated image gallery, improving content management and visualization. Throughout the project, I defined and managed tasks within the team to optimize workflow and coordination.
experiences.aktiosDescription: Experience developing a variety of projects, ranging from web platforms to mobile applications. I contributed to an online ferry ticket sales platform that integrates multiple companies, allowing users to compare prices and choose the most affordable option, working closely with the tech lead on key architectural decisions to ensure scalability and maintainability. I've implemented authentication flows across multiple projects and completely rebuilt the backend of an application, covering everything from data modeling and architecture to final implementation. Additionally, I built a dashboard for visualizing electricity consumption through interactive charts and developed screens for a mobile application using Expo (React Native).

projects.title: Projects
projects.omnistockDescription: OmniStock is an inventory management platform designed for businesses of all sizes—from shops and workshops to libraries and rental services. It combines consumable stock control, loan management, traceability, and smart alerts into a single interface.
projects.intolerantiaDescription: A web app that uses AI to help users identify food intolerances based on their symptoms.IntolerantIA is an app where you will be able to take a quick look at the restaurant's menu to see what foods you can and cannot eat. Especially useful for people with allergies and intolerances.
projects.myportfolioDescription: MyPortfolio is a web application that allows developers and professionals in the technology sector to quickly and easily create their own portfolio and resume using their GitHub account to register.
projects.loopDescription: Online store created for practice using Next.js, Stripe, and Turso.
projects.planetManagementSystemDescription: A Star Wars–based Planet Management System built with Next.js and Zustand.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.text: Hi, I’m Alejandro 👋. Besides being passionate about programming, I love staying active and enjoying the outdoors. You can usually find me skating, snowboarding, hitting the gym, or playing padel from time to time. I’m also a fan of video games, traveling, and mountain getaways, where I find the perfect mix of adventure and relaxation.
